features.name: time_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized continuous feature for the linear SVM, ensuring the time scale does not dominate the margin.

features.name: length_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardizes flight length, allowing the SVM to weigh duration equally with other scaled features.

features.name: log_length
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme long-haul flights on the linear decision boundary by compressing the right tail.

features.name: is_weekend
features.description: Binary indicator for weekend flights (Saturday or Sunday).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a discrete shift in the linear margin for weekend flights, capturing weekly operational differences.

features.name: is_evening_rush
features.description: Binary indicator for flights departing during the evening rush (16:00 to 19:00).
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to apply a specific weight to flights departing during peak evening hours.

features.name: time_length_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between standardized departure time and standardized flight length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly provides the interaction between departure time and flight duration, which a linear SVM cannot learn natively.

features.name: time_squared_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a non-linear (quadratic) transformation of time, enabling the linear SVM to capture parabolic time-of-day effects.

features.name: time_to_midnight_scaled
features.description: Proximity to midnight, scaled to a 0-1 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures proximity to midnight as a continuous feature, useful for modeling end-of-day operational resets.

features.name: arrival_time_proxy_scaled
features.description: Estimated arrival time (time + length modulo 1440), scaled to a 0-1 range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Estimates the arrival time on a normalized scale, providing a proxy for destination-side temporal effects.

features.name: airline_tier
features.description: Judgment feature assigning a tier to the airline based on its code (e.g., 1.0 for major legacy carriers, 0.5 for low-cost, 0.0 for regional).
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical airline codes into a continuous ordinal scale based on carrier size, suitable for linear weighting.

features.name: airport_from_hub_status
features.description: Judgment feature assigning a hub status score to the departure airport (1.0 for major international hubs, 0.5 for medium hubs, 0.0 for small regional airports).
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes departure airport size into a continuous feature, allowing the SVM to learn a linear relationship with hub congestion.

features.name: airport_to_hub_status
features.description: Judgment feature assigning a hub status score to the arrival airport (1.0 for major international hubs, 0.5 for medium hubs, 0.0 for small regional airports).
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes arrival airport size into a continuous feature, allowing the SVM to learn a linear relationship with destination congestion.
